_doc: Proximity Alarm (defender pool; research/gadgets.md §4.5). Two each; thrown, it sticks where it hits (Y5S2); electronic. Picking it up again and its size are placeholders. One bullet destroys it (siege.gg). Its alarm (M3): it sounds, for both teams, while an attacker's body is within 3 m (Fandom, siege.gg), from 1 s after it sticks (ours: "a short delay"); drones don't set it off. In a match's prep it can't go outdoors (one that comes to rest outdoors then is destroyed: ours).
name: Proximity Alarm
